cardOverview.overviewText: The AU KOSMO Credit Card is a lifetime-free, UPI-enabled credit card designed for digital-first users, offering Kiwi Rewards on everyday spends across UPI Scan & Pay, online shopping, and POS/contactless payments.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: Flat Rs. 500 Instant Discount Min. bill of ₹6000.|Valid once per card per month

benefitRows.name: EMI on UPI
benefitRows.offer: 50% of the interest or ₹1,500, whichever is lower will be returned as cashback for 3-Month EMI and Up to 30% of the interest will be returned as cashback for Tenures > 3 months.|Maximum Transaction of ₹75,000 is eligible.
